## Documentation Issue
A clear description of the documentation issue or improvement.

## Current State
What is the current state of the documentation? Include specific file names and sections if applicable.

## Desired State
What should the documentation look like? Be specific about what should be added, changed, or removed.

## Type of Documentation
- [ ] AGENTS.md or core guidance
- [ ] Policy documentation (policies/)
- [ ] Template documentation (templates/)
- [ ] Prompt documentation (prompts/)
- [ ] Inventory reference (inventory/)
- [ ] CI/CD documentation (ci/)
- [ ] Hooks documentation (hooks/)
- [ ] README or project documentation
- [ ] Navigation helpers (docs/)

## Impact
Who would benefit from this documentation improvement?
- New users starting projects
- Returning users working on existing projects
- AI agents using the template
- Maintainers and contributors

## Related Files
List specific files that would need to be updated:
- `path/to/file.md`
- `path/to/another-file.md`

## Additional Context
Add any other context, screenshots, or examples about the documentation issue.
